Fredericksburg 11800 Main St, BLDG 3 Fredericksburg, VA 22408 540-385-9360 Mon & Tue: 4pm - 9pm Wed & Thurs: 2pm - 9pm Friday: 2pm - 10pm Saturday: 12pm - 10pm Sunday: 12pm - 8pm

Our name and our logo honors the Maltese Cross, a centuries-old emblem of courage and self-sacrifice. First carried by the Knights of Malta, the cross was adopted by firefighters to symbolize the promise to protect others, even at personal risk.
Founded in 2015 by two firefighters with a love for craft beer, Maltese Brewing Co. has grown into one of the oldest and most respected breweries in Fredericksburg.
